thread:
maria: early heads-up — pushed kernel patch to reduce spin in the batcher. microbench shows ~4-6% tail latency improvement p95/p99 for seq_len=128. pls review when free.

aj: nice, which branch?

maria: branch=eng/kern/batcher-spinfix, PR #412. main change is avoiding a contended atomic in the hot path — small diff.

ken: pinged on PR, left 2 nits about comments. do we have perf artifacts uploaded?

maria: uploaded: https://artifacts/redwood/bench/1876543210/batch-spinfix.html. TL;DR: p95 down 72ms->68ms at 4k qps; p99 shows smaller improvement but less noisy. full CSV attached there.

sofia: quick kv note — I'm seeing a spike in miss-rate for long streaming prompts after ~20s wall time. looks like eviction policy thrashes with pinned streaming prefixes.

aj: is that still the size-aware LRU we switched to last week?

sofia: yes. edge-case: streaming requests pin very large prefix entries, which evicts multiple smaller useful entries. thinking of a soft-pin with short TTL for streaming.

maria: can we add a short TTL for streaming pins (3s) and then demote to normal LRU? should reduce thrash while keeping warm cache behavior.

ken: we experimented with TTL=1s before; jitter made effective warmup inconsistent. maybe use decay on pin score (score *= 0.8 every second) instead of hard TTL.

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled to eng-runtime-canary in 30m — routing 2% traffic to the new batcher variant. Monitor p50/p95/p99 and error rate.

aj: noted. I'll watch the canary and abort if 99th percentile latency increases >10% for 5 consecutive mins.

sofia: blocker: we don't have trace IDs in batcher logs right now, so correlating miss spikes to request traces is hard. who can add a trace header propagation?

maria: I can add trace-id passthrough to the batcher logging path in the next PR — ETA ~1h.

aj: thanks. after that I'll rerun microbench with kv warmup ON/OFF and post diffs. would like both batcher-spinfix and baseline for comparison.

ken: small ops ask: if you change kernel behavior, add a short changelog snippet under /changelogs/kern/batcher.md so release notes capture perf rationale.

maria: will add it to the PR.

sofia: I'll continue running eviction traces and post a short summary (miss-rate by sequence length + top keys evicted) here once done.

aj: perfect. ping here when artifacts are uploaded and when canary is stable. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks everyone — will update PR with trace-id change and changelog. monitoring after canary goes live.

ken: if anyone wants extra data, I can run a targeted 10m soak at 8k qps against canary after warmup. say the word.

sofia: would be useful, thanks. I'll coordinate timing.

aj: sounds good. short sync in thread only — no meeting unless we see regression.

maria: +1, cheers.
